definition.name: Signed finite Task.Wait cancellation and physical retirement

steps.name: Fetch only the immutable producer source before its verification
Check exact finite wait selection results and original lifecycle boundaries
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_finite_task_wait tools.tests.test_dotnet_finite_wait_programme tools.tests.test_dotnet_finite_filesystem tools.tests.test_dotnet_task_wait tools.tests.test_dotnet_resource_timer_observer -v

steps.name: Install the normal captured compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Prepare the pinned compiler and small current closed-runtime adapters
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-finite-wait-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-finite-wait-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-finite-wait-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-finite-wait-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Authenticate the exact Wasmtime 48.0.7 products without a native host rebuild
Capture one fresh offline NativeAOT component and run eighteen strict wait outcomes
Retain bounded public build identities and raw lifecycle outcomes
